title: Live usage edge cases: no result event, non-claude cost, multi-message sum, total dip

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S99 later notes: (1) a Claude role that ends without a result event shows tokens 0 $0.00 instead of unknown (untested); (2) cost is known only when the vendor is claude, so a future cost-reporting vendor shows $- until updated; (3) live usage summed over several Claude messages is checked against the result event only on a single-message fixture (23763 tokens); (4) the run token total dips briefly at round end.

S31 screenshot (2026-10-26): a run recorded by an older daemon build has no tokens or cost fields on its roles, and the pane shows 'tokens 0  $-' / 'tokens 0  $0.00' on every finished role; a missing field should read 'tokens -'.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestRoleWithoutResultShowsUnknownUsage; TestMultiMessageUsageMatchesResult (a recorded multi-message stream fixture); TestRunTokenTotalDoesNotDipAtRoundEnd.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor from the code. Build a multi-message claude stream fixture without real credentials (hand-built from the stream-json shape in testdata/vendors/claude/02-stream-json.stdout). Key cost-known on an adapter capability rather than the vendor name.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/daemon ./internal/engine ./internal/agent/... ./internal/tui; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
